nodes.label: YAML-to-env-var injection pattern
nodes.rationale: YAML values are injected as env vars at lower priority than real env vars so Pydantic BaseSettings env-var override semantics apply automatically without custom merging logic.

nodes.label: WAL mode + foreign key enforcement pattern
nodes.rationale: WAL mode is enabled for concurrent read performance and foreign keys are enforced on every connection to preserve referential integrity without locking overhead.
nodes.norm_label: wal mode + foreign key enforcement pattern

nodes.label: Defense-in-depth layered AV engine
nodes.rationale: Each detection layer (static, behavioral, network, cloud, ML) is developed independently so failures or gaps in one layer are compensated by others, enabling incremental phase-by-phase delivery.

nodes.label: Async-first I/O design principle
nodes.rationale: All DB and I/O code is async; asyncio.run() is used only at the CLI boundary to prevent blocking the event loop during future real-time protection work.
